findings.title: Pinned pipeline executes an unvalidated interpreter from a predictable path
findings.publicSummary: run-pinned.sh reuses an existing virtual environment interpreter at a predictable cache path without validating it, and runs both pipeline stages through it. Requires a local user on a shared host with an unset TMPDIR. Not applicable on macOS defaults or to the project CI, which sets the cache directory explicitly.
findings.remediation: Create the virtual environment in a directory the script owns, or verify the interpreter was produced by this script before using it.

findings.title: Settlement object does not apply the fail-closed policy used for the payload
findings.publicSummary: Unknown extensions are rejected in the payload and requirements but accepted in the settlement, which also accepts success true together with errorReason or errorMessage. Unevaluated and contradictory content can appear in a case marked consistent.
findings.remediation: Apply the same fail-closed check to settlement extensions and extra, and reject error fields when success is true.

findings.title: Resource is not bound to the AP2 mandate and the boundary reads as though it were
findings.publicSummary: The verifier never reads the x402 payload resource, so its fields can change without affecting the decision. The implementation is correct because AP2 carries no equivalent field; the guarantee boundary is what reads wider than the exclusions state.
findings.remediation: Add a right-hand column entry stating the resource is not bound to the AP2 mandate.

findings.title: Evidence RPC endpoint is not validated
findings.publicSummary: PULSE_EVM_RPC_URL is required to be non-empty but its scheme and shape are not validated, so a plaintext endpoint or a typo is used silently. Outside the declared offline boundary.
findings.remediation: Require https and validate the URL.

remediationSummary: All four findings are open at the time of publication. None is critical or high. TPAI-1 was reported through the repository private vulnerability reporting form before publication.
residualRisk: Bounded to the reviewed commit. The offline decision boundary held under every constructed input. The findings concern the surfaces around it and the regeneration pipeline. This review does not establish production readiness, protocol conformance, live settlement or custody assurance.
